reuse.why: Ignores the existing notes table (notes keyed by entity id, read elsewhere in budget/actions.ts) by adding a new category_groups.notes column, and writes its own case-insensitive #fixed regex instead of the shared tag parser extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The group-notes join, the widened row type and the isFixedGroup skip are pasted into each of the six month-wide actions instead of being factored into a shared category selection.

placement.why: Storage for group notes is invented in the schema layer via a migration rather than read from the notes module's table, and the exclusion rule is spread over every action instead of a single selection point.

scope.why: Adds an unrequested schema migration and a DbCategoryGroup field on top of the action changes.

maintainability.why: Tags written in the group notes UI land in the notes table, not the new column, so the rule reads a column nothing populates; and changing the exclusion means editing six queries and six loops.

bypasses_abstraction.where: migration 1791816749591_add_category_group_notes.sql and g.notes reads in budget/actions.ts bypass the notes table / notes module; isFixedGroup's regex bypasses shared/tags.ts tag extraction

one_place.where: isFixedGroup is one predicate, but the group-notes fetch and the skip are repeated separately in copyPreviousMonth (via getBudgetData), setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and set6MonthAvg
